releaseNotes:
Nodecast-TV Features & Ultra-Fast TV UI:
  Dedicated TV Series Support: Indian TV Series (890+ shows), Netflix & Streaming Series, Latest Releases, and Docuseries with multi-season pills and episode lists
  Cable-TV Style Fast Channel Zap HUD: Instant corner banner with channel number, logo, clean title, subcategory, and stream quality
  High Performance 30-Card Batching: Smooth 60fps scrolling across 7,000+ channel playlists with virtualized batch rendering
  Purged All ##### Divider Cards & 24/7 Loops: Cleaned all channel lists and separated Malayalam channels into true subcategories (General, News, Entertainment, Movies, Kids, etc.)
  Expanded Malayalam & South Indian VOD: Preloads 3,360+ movies into global search memory with smart TMDB metadata and intelligent deduplication
